headline: Withings charges new users to sync health data
summary: Withings now requires new users to pay $100 a year to sync their fitness and health data to third-party apps such as Apple Health, gating that access behind its own subscription plan.

claims.statement: Withings now charges new users $100 per year to sync their health data to third-party apps like Apple Health.

sources.quote: Withings now charges $100 per year to sync your data to other apps
Withings wants new users to pay $100 a year to sync with Apple Health

claims.statement: The policy applies to new Withings accounts created from October 13th.

sources.quote: If you're a new user of Withings' fitness-tracking smartwatches or smart scales and want to sync and access your health data through third party apps like Apple Health or Google Health it's now going to cost you.
